subject: Pen test orchestration: access window, scope update, and report handoff timeline
messages:
From: Sofia Costa <sofia@rapidassess.io>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: RapidAssess: initial availability for external pen test (proposed windows)

Hi Aditya,

Thanks for the quick intro call earlier. Per our conversation, RapidAssess can run an external application-layer penetration test against Redwood's public staging and preprod web endpoints. Proposed windows: Nov 15-17 or Nov 29-Dec 1 (US Pacific business hours).

Scope (proposal):
- External network discovery and web application auth flows (login, oauth callback, API endpoints)
- No simulated DB writes or destructive tests without explicit sign-off
- Basic credentialed scanning (test account provided by you)

Please confirm:
1) Which window works for you?
2) Confirm scope (we included only external/app layer; if you want internal/VPC tests we need additional approvals)
3) Any IPs to whitelist + preferred SSH jump host or credential delivery method?

Attached: initial_statement_of_work.pdf (SOW stub) and a short checklist for access.

Deliverables we typically provide: preliminary findings (48h after active testing completes), final report (10 business days), and an options sheet for retest/verification.

We can also include SOC 2-oriented evidence (templated executive summary and proof of remediation) if you tell us which controls you are mapping to.

Best,
Sofia Costa
Operations Lead, RapidAssess
sofia@rapidassess.io
+1 (415) 555-0196

---
Attachment: initial_statement_of_work.pdf (application/pdf, 246KB)
From: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
To: Sofia Costa <sofia@rapidassess.io>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-01T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RapidAssess: initial availability for external pen test (proposed windows)

Sofia — thanks. Nov 15-17 is preferred. A few clarifications and requests up front:

- Confirmed scope: external perimeter + webapp auth/API flows only. Do not test internal VPC subnets or our production write paths. We will provide dedicated test accounts (non-prod) and an allowlist for those user agents.
- Deliverables: SOC 2 requires an explicit remediation timeline in the report and a CSV/translatable tracker we can ingest into our internal remediation dashboard. Please include an executive summary that maps findings to common SOC 2 categories (CC6, CC7) where applicable.
- For credential delivery we prefer a short-lived vault secret (HashiCorp Vault) — I will work with Security to create a read-only lease.
- CC'ing Marissa so Procurement can start the PO/contract side.

Attachments: redwood_scope_matrix_v1.xlsx (contains the endpoints and a quick 'do not test' list).

Can you also confirm RapidAssess' IP ranges for whitelisting and whether you need MFA/SSO access to the staging console (we'd rather provide a fine-grained test account).

Aditya Rao
Director, Product Infrastructure
Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.ai
---
Attachment: redwood_scope_matrix_v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 32KB)
From: Sofia Costa <sofia@rapidassess.io>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-02T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RapidAssess: initial availability for external pen test (proposed windows)

Thanks Aditya — scope confirmed on our side (external + auth flows). A few items we need to proceed:

- IPs for allowlisting: 54.23.11.9, 54.23.11.10, 18.204.2.33 (we recommend those be whitelisted for Nov 15-17).
- Credential method: Vault lease works. Please create a role for key_readonly_test with a 72-hour TTL and include the lease path. Alternatively, we can accept a temporary SAML-linked test user.
- Access mechanics doc attached: access_instructions.txt (contains our typical SSH jump host + test account conventions).
- Contract/PO: we can proceed under the SOW in the attached draft, but we do need a signed agreement before test start. I'll ping Procurement directly if helpful.

We will provide a preliminary findings summary within 48 hours of completing active testing and the final report 10 business days after the last test day. The final report will include: technical findings, PoC steps (non-destructive), risk rating, remediation guidance, and an executive summary tailored for SOC 2 evidence. We also include a remediation tracker CSV upon delivery.

Sofia
---
Attachment: access_instructions.txt (text/plain, 3KB)
From: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-02T11:15:00-07:00
Subject: FW: RapidAssess: initial availability for external pen test (procurement + security ops)

Stephanie / Rishi — looping you both in to expedite vendor onboarding for a pen test tied to an incoming customer audit (Acme SaaS). Actions: 

1) Procurement (Marissa) — please review the attached SOW and create a PO against RapidAssess. They require a signed agreement before Nov 12 to onboard for the Nov 15 window.
2) Security/Infra (Rishi) — please whitelist these IPs on the staging perimeter for the window Nov 15-17: 54.23.11.9, 54.23.11.10, 18.204.2.33. Also create a Vault role key_readonly_test with a 72-hour TTL; I'll send the lease path when ready.
3) Operations (Stephanie) — coordinate with App owners to ensure the test accounts listed in redwood_scope_matrix_v1.xlsx exist and have the limited permissions called out.

We don't want any production write operations performed — confirm with RapidAssess that any verified PoC steps will be non-destructive and that they will coordinate if escalation is required.

Thanks — target to have PO and whitelists completed by EOD Nov 11 so we can keep Nov 15.

Aditya

(Inline: redwood_scope_matrix_v1.xlsx)

Subject: RapidAssess: confirmed schedule, final scope matrix and pre-test checklist

Hi Aditya / Marissa —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Confirming Nov 15-17 as booked for RapidAssess engagement. Items attached: final_scope_matrix.xlsx and sow_rev2.pdf which reflect your 'external + auth flows' limitation and the agreed non-destructive test constraint.

Deliverable timeline (confirmed):
- Preliminary findings: within 48 hours after last active test day (expected Nov 19)
- Final report: within 10 business days after last active test (expected Nov 29)
- Remediation tracker: CSV included with final report; we provide an initial CSV with the final report and an updated CSV after validation retest if requested.
- Retest: we offer a single validation retest within 15 days of remediation delivery; retest scheduling will be coordinated via this thread.

Pre-test asks:
- Please sign the attached agreement via DocuSign: https://docusign.com/embedded/sig/abcd-1234 (SOW references)
- Provide Vault lease path for key_readonly_test OR a temp SAML test user prior to Nov 14 17:00 PT
- Confirm IP allowlist done and App owners are aware of test windows

Attachments: final_scope_matrix.xlsx, sow_rev2.pdf

We will include a mapping table for SOC 2 evidence points in the final executive summary.

Sofia
Operations Lead, RapidAssess
